code-small.use: Mechanical edits: renames, formatting, small fixes with an obvious solution, lookups, simple scripts

code.use: Everyday feature work and bug fixes with a clear spec

code-complex.use: Architecture, hard bugs, concurrency and cancellation, security-sensitive code, large refactors

review.use: Reviewing code, specs and ADRs; finding subtle problems is worth the cost

research.use: Searching code and documentation, comparing options, summarising sources

planning.use: Specifications, plans and breaking work down; mistakes here multiply downstream

writing.use: Content, documentation and copy for people; language quality matters more than speed

marketing.use: Positioning, marketing plans, campaigns and communication

checkup.use: Recurring checkups: long, careful audits with many tool calls, run often enough that cost matters
